reason: The formula is an internal helper in the full journal validation pipeline. validate first type-checks DataSize as an integer and rejects unsupported tree sizes before its sole call to validate_pacing. Thus only 10000 or 100000 reaches the deep-tree formula through the CLI/validated journal entry point. An explicit duplicate lookup in the helper is optional defensive duplication, not a correction to an actually admitted unsupported journal.
